title: Musicians' views of John Hammond and Joe Glaser
summary: Nobody said anything bad of Hammond; Glaser was disliked but would bawl you out if you asked for much.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: What was the general attitude of the musicians - not only yourself - towards John Hammond?
The ones that I know about, I never heard nothing bad about him.
What did they think of Joe Glaser?
A lot of people said he was no good, but you had to understand him.
Well, he was going to bawl you out if you asked for a lot of money...
What do you mean a whole lot of money?
